_template_notes.purpose: Frontend Permission graph — Discovery Plugin #9 (v2.0 Gói C++). Parse UI permission guards: <PermissionGate permission='...'>, usePermission('...'), <Can permission='...'>, useAuth().hasPermission('...'). Source: Grep `apps/erp-web/**/*.{tsx,ts}` cho permission-guarded UI elements. Consumed by lanes CD15 (UI Permission Mirror) + CD38 (UI Implementation Coverage) qua graph_dependency.
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per UI element guarded — {id, name, kind, module, file_path, line, permission, guard_pattern, fingerprint}
nodes[].permission: format `{module}.{resource}.{action}` (vd 'crm.customer.read') — MUST match backend RBAC catalog
edges[]: 1 entry per ui_element → permission_required — {from_element, to_permission, kind: 'guards', uncertain: boolean}
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' Grep-based; v2.1 → ts-morph cho dynamic permission expression resolution
metadata.unique_permissions_used: count distinct permissions across nodes (cross-ref với rbac-permission-catalog.json)
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/erp-web/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (per CD15 graph_dependency optional, E137 WARN)
Project không dùng permission pattern → empty nodes[] (CD15 lane fallback Grep với E139 WARN)
